thread.title: Notable Wednesday Option Activity: AAPL, INTC, AMD

title: Notable Wednesday Option Activity: AAPL, INTC, AMD
text: January 03, 2018 at 13:26 PM EST Notable Wednesday Option Activity: AAPL, INTC, AMD Looking at options trading activity among components of the S&P 500 index, there is noteworthy activity today in Apple Inc (AAPL), where a total volume of 265,564 contracts has been traded thus far today, a contract volume which is representative of approximately 26.6 million underlying shares (given that every 1 contract represents 100 underlying shares). That number works out to 102.8% of AAPL's average daily trading volume over the past month, of 25.8 million shares..
